title: Rollout memo whose headline latency gain comes from a benchmark file that was not supplied, and whose payback claim has no data behind it

planted.why: the whole case rests on a 38% latency gain whose source file was not supplied; the number can be neither confirmed nor refuted
'faster pages lift conversion, so it pays for itself within a quarter' has no conversion or revenue figure anywhere

proof.python:
import os
m = open('memo.md').read()
assert 'bench/pilot_p95.csv' in m and not os.path.exists('bench/pilot_p95.csv')
assert 3 * 1400 == 4200 and 9 * 1400 == 12600 and 12600 * 12 == 151200 and '$1,400' in open('pricing.md').read() and 'Regions served by the company: 9' in open('pricing.md').read()
assert 'conversion' in m and 'revenue' not in m
